title: Conservation of Mass
summary: Atoms are never created or destroyed, so the total mass never changes in a reaction, even when it looks like it does.

ib.note: Leads to balancing equations and stoichiometry (MYP 4–5)

cbse.chapter: Ch 3: Atoms and Molecules (law of conservation of mass)

objectives: I can state the law of conservation of mass.
I can explain why mass seems to change in open containers, using the particle model.
I can calculate the mass of a missing reactant or product.
I can plan an experiment that shows mass is conserved (closed system).
misconceptions: Mass is lost when something burns (it just goes into the air as gases).
When a substance dissolves or reacts, its atoms disappear.
